title: Claims Training Notes: Last Covered Day of a Customer-Arranged Cardinal Rental Reimbursement Rental
content:
These training notes cover how the last covered day of a rental the customer arranged under Cardinal Rental Reimbursement is set. It depends on how the rental ended, as shown on the claim's rental ledger.

**When does the customer-arranged rental's coverage stop if a rental car authorization took over?**
When a rental car authorization on the claim was entered on the end date of the customer-arranged rental's closing, the last covered day is the day before that car's start date.

**And if the customer-arranged rental has not been closed?**
When the customer-arranged rental has no closing on the ledger, the last covered day is the last of its authorized days. The authorized days are the authorization plus every extension of it, counted from the start date.

**In every other case?**
The last covered day is the end date of its closing.

The covered days run through the last covered day, that day included.

## Practice examples (hypothetical, rental starting September 1)

1. The rental closed with an end date of September 9. A rental car authorization entered on September 9 shows a start date of September 8. The last covered day is September 7.
2. The rental closed with an end date of September 9, and no rental car authorization was entered on September 9. The last covered day is September 9.
3. The rental has 5 authorized days plus a 5-day extension, and no closing. The last covered day is September 10.
